entries.reason: iOS 6 has the video format description and its avcC atom, and only lacks the function that reads the parameter sets out of it
entries.effect: answers the SPS, PPS and extension sets of the avcC atom by index with the count and the NAL unit header length, and the errors -12710 and -12712 the host answers for the same descriptions
entries.source: the host's own CoreMedia, which the port is held against, case by case, by tests/backports/host/coremedia; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3, asked with dlsym, for what iOS 6 exports
